sentence: This project builds a tool that uses deep learning and a microscope to detect epithelial cancers early.
This project designs a hybrid quantum network and the methods needed to share entanglement across long distances.
This project studies how soot particles form in wildfires and builds a model to predict it.
This project holds a symposium that brings scientists together to discuss stem cell and developmental biology research.
This project builds computer methods that find the best swimming motions of microorganisms and control how liquid crystals assemble.
This project studies how phytoplankton are spread across the Pacific Ocean and which nutrients limit them, using genetic tools and machine learning.
This project develops fast computer methods for solving large nested optimization problems that come up in machine learning.
This project tries to make ceramics resist cracks by adding metallic features and uses machine learning to speed up the design.
This project builds a framework that combines optimization methods with deep neural networks so their answers are easier to understand and trust.
This project uses wearable sensors and machine learning to help exoskeletons assist people with many everyday tasks.
This project builds a sensor system that uses machine learning to correct Global Positioning System errors in dense urban areas.
This project builds hydrogel-MXene biosensors that detect low levels of colorectal cancer biomarkers in simulated intestinal environments.
This project develops methods to measure selenium isotopes in seawater and marine sediments and uses them to track oxygen and nutrients.
This project tests whether microbes can remove toxic perchlorate salts from Martian regolith and turn it into soil that supports plant growth.
This project tries to find out how wasps make oak plants grow galls by studying the genes of the wasps and the plants.
This project develops ways to make large artificial intelligence systems run faster and use less energy.
